topics: Derivation of density of electrons in conduction band and density of holes in valence band
Variation of Intrinsic carrier concentration with temperature
Fermi level in semiconductors-intrinsic and extrinsic
Energy band diagram of p-n junction - Qualitative description of charge flow across a p-n junction - Forward and reverse biased p-n junctions
Semiconductor devices - Rectifiers- Full wave and Half wave
Zener diode - V-I characteristics - Zener breakdown and Avalanche breakdown
Applications of Zener and Tunnel diodes.
Photonic devices (qualitative) - Photo detectors (Junction and PIN photodiodes)
Stringing of Solar cells to solar panel
Type I and Type II Super conductors
Relation between polarization and dielectric constant
Internal fields in liquids and solids
Optical processes - Absorption, Spontaneous emission and stimulated emission
Principle of laser - conditions for sustained lasing – Population inversion
Basic components of laser - Active medium- Optical resonant cavity
Construction and working of Ruby laser
Optical fiber-Principle of propagation of light
Types of fibers-Step index and Graded index fibers
Applications of optical fibers - Fiber optic communication system (block diagram)

2 Questions from each module.
Total of 8 Questions, each carrying 3 marks

partB.description:
Each question carries 9 marks.
Two questions will be given from each module, out of which 1 question should be answered.
Each question can have a maximum of 3 sub divisions.

courseOutcomes.description: Explain the fundamentals of Semiconductor Physics.
Describe the behaviour of semiconductor materials in semiconductor devices.
Explain Superconductivity and basic theory of dielectrics
Apply the comprehended knowledge about laser and fiber optics in various engineering applications
Apply basic knowledge of principles and theories in physics to conduct experiments.
